name: crosstalk
description: See every Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI chat in one place, and let them share what they did. A map of your code for agents, ready-made commands, and your plan limits.

enumDescriptions: About 2k tokens of the conversation on connecting
About 6k tokens of the conversation on connecting
About 15k tokens of the conversation on connecting
crosstalk.contextSize.description: How much of a chat's conversation another chat gets when the two are connected. The rest is always in its flightlog, which the other chat can read.

crosstalk.autoDeliver.description: When a connected chat finishes a reply, give it the updates that arrived while it worked right away. That costs it an extra turn (and its tokens) just to read them. Off (the default): updates wait for its next message, at no extra cost.

crosstalk.codeMap.enabled.description: Keep a code map of each open folder, so AI chats can find code in a few hundred tokens instead of searching and opening files. Built by a parser on this computer (no AI), kept in ~/.crosstalk/codemap, about 1 MB for a large repo.

crosstalk.backupFolder.description: A folder to back up the session logs and your own commands to, every half hour (for example a folder in iCloud Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox). Empty: no backup. The code map isn't backed up; it's rebuilt from the code in seconds.
